SceneAct API (all coordinates in a world frame with Z up; angles in degrees):
from sceneact import *
Scene(name='Scene'), Asset(name='Asset'), Part(name, *nodes)
parent.include(name, node) attaches an asset/part while preserving its world position.
parent.members[name] retrieves a child; parent.remove(name) detaches it.
node.clone() returns an independent subtree. scene.replicate(name, new_name) duplicates an asset.
box(size=(x,y,z), center=(x,y,z), color=(r,g,b), opacity=1)
ball(radius, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1), opacity=1)
rod(radius, start=(x,y,z), end=(x,y,z), color=(1,1,1))
rod(radius, length=h, center=(0,0,0), axis='+z', color=(1,1,1))
fillet_box(size=(x,y,z), radius=r, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1))
sweep_tube(points=[(x,y,z), ...], radius=.03, color=(1,1,1))
assemble(nodes, name='Assembly') groups shapes without merging their meshes.
fuse(*nodes), subtract(base,*cutters), overlap(*nodes), exclusive(left,right) construct solids.
node.move(offset), node.turn(axis, degrees, pivot=None), node.resize(factors, pivot=None)
modify a node and its descendants. node.turn(euler=(rx,ry,rz)) applies X, then Y, then Z.
Default rotation/scale pivot is the geometry's world-space bounding-box center.
shifted(node, offset), turned(node, axis, degrees, pivot=None, euler=None),
resized(node, factors, pivot=None) perform the same operations on independent copies.
node.paint(color, opacity=1) applies color to the subtree; node.rgba reads its finish.
node.centroid, node.dimensions, node.limits give AABB center, size, (minimum,maximum).
node.landmark('top'), node.landmark('front_left_bottom') return bounding-box anchors.
node.extreme(direction) returns a support point; projected_span(node,direction) returns bounds
along a unit direction; projected_width(node,direction) returns their difference.
snap(node, target, source_anchor='bottom', target_anchor='top', offset=(0,0,0)) returns a copy.
A target can also be a world point; then omit target_anchor.
abut(node, target, axis='+z', gap=0) places a copy after a target boundary.
center_on(node, target, axes=('x','y','z')) aligns selected center coordinates.
offset_at(node, reference, offsets) positions selected coordinates; None preserves a coordinate.
repeat_line(nodes, axis='+x', spacing=1) uses equal center spacing, keeping the first fixed.
pile(nodes, axis='+z', gap=0) spaces bounding surfaces, keeping the first fixed.
lattice(nodes, rows=None, columns=None, spacing=(1,1), plane='xy', center=(0,0,0), order='row-major')
orbit(nodes, radius, axis='+z', center=(0,0,0), start=0, sweep=360, orient=False, rotation_offset=0)
Layout functions return assemblies of independent copies.
scene.bind(source,target,source_anchor='bottom',target_anchor='top',offset=(0,0,0))
registers a persistent relation between scene members; scene.settle() updates dependencies.
realize(scene) settles constraints and creates Blender geometry, clearing Blender first.
set_view(position,target,lens=35,sensor=36,shift=(0,0)) creates the active camera.
area_emitter(position,power=500,size=5,target=(0,0,0),color=(1,1,1)) creates an area light.
Call realize before setting the camera and lighting. Estimate the input viewpoint yourself.

from sceneact import *
import bpy, math, random
from mathutils import Vector

# Main proportions and viewpoint
CHAISE_LENGTH = 3.05
CHAISE_WIDTH = 1.10
SEAT_HEIGHT = .79
CAMERA_POSITION = (2.75, -5.2, 3.65)
CAMERA_TARGET = (0, .08, .99)
CAMERA_LENS = 51
random.seed(8)

scene = Scene("French chaise longue")
ivory = (.71, .68, .58)
wall = (.76, .73, .64)
trim = (.82, .79, .68)
green = (.31, .37, .30)
gold = (.61, .53, .35)
pale_gold = (.77, .69, .48)
fabric = (.84, .79, .66)
rose = (.55, .34, .32)

room = Asset("Paneled room")
room.include("floor", box((12, 12, .12), center=(0, 0, -.08),
                          color=(.19, .105, .065)))
room.include("back_wall", box((9, .16, 4.3), center=(0, 1.18, 2.12), color=wall))
# Architectural dado, rails, and recessed panel moldings.
for i, (z, thick, depth) in enumerate([
    (.12, .15, .12), (.24, .045, .07), (.36, .045, .065),
    (1.94, .075, .08), (2.04, .035, .06), (2.40, .055, .06),
    (2.72, .05, .065), (2.85, .035, .05)
]):
    room.include("horizontal_molding_%d" % i,
                 box((8.7, depth, thick), center=(0, 1.055, z), color=trim))

for p, (left, right) in enumerate([(-3.0, -1.75), (-1.69, 2.1), (2.17, 3.4)]):
    for layer in range(3):
        inset = layer * .025
        lo, hi = .45 + inset, 1.83 - inset
        a, b = left + inset, right - inset
        c = trim if layer != 1 else (.62, .59, .50)
        for j, xx in enumerate((a, b)):
            room.include("panel_%d_%d_v%d" % (p, layer, j),
                         box((.018, .035, hi-lo), center=(xx, 1.069-layer*.009, (hi+lo)/2), color=c))
        for j, zz in enumerate((lo, hi)):
            room.include("panel_%d_%d_h%d" % (p, layer, j),
                         box((b-a, .035, .018), center=((a+b)/2, 1.069-layer*.009, zz), color=c))
# Vertical joints in the wall.
for j, xx in enumerate((-1.72, .64)):
    room.include("wall_joint_%d" % j,
                 box((.009, .006, 3.9), center=(xx, 1.086, 2.02), color=(.40,.38,.32)))
# Right doorway/pilaster.
room.include("right_pilaster", box((.30, .34, 3.2), center=(2.62, .94, 1.58), color=trim))
room.include("right_wall_return", box((.9, .7, 3.3), center=(3.16, 1.38, 1.6), color=ivory))

# Parquet strips, laid as short interlocking diagonal boards.

    for col in range(-12, 13):
        x = (col + row) * .255
        y = (col - row) * .255
        if abs(x) > 5 or abs(y) > 5:

        for k in range(2):
            plank = box((.50, .125, .018),
                        center=(x + k*.088, y + k*.088, -.008),
                        color=random.choice(wood_colors))

chaise = Asset("Chaise longue")
# Visible, curved apron and double bead along its front.
front_rail = [(-1.30,-.565,.66),(-1.03,-.57,.60),(-.70,-.575,.58),

              (1.15,-.55,.55),(1.43,-.43,.57)]

for j, dz in enumerate((-.047, .045)):

                              radius=.012, color=pale_gold))
chaise.include("rear_rail",
               sweep_tube(points=[(-1.4,.48,.64),(-.7,.53,.61),(.5,.53,.60),(1.42,.41,.60)],

chaise.include("foot_end_rail",
               sweep_tube(points=[(1.43,-.45,.58),(1.52,-.20,.59),(1.54,.15,.60),(1.43,.45,.61)],
                          radius=.055,color=green))

# Slender cabriole legs with curved knees and small feet.
for i, (x,y) in enumerate([(-1.14,-.49),(1.28,-.44),(-1.16,.43),(1.29,.41)]):

         (x-side*.035,y-.025,.29),(x-side*.015,y-.045,.12),

    chaise.include("cabriole_leg_%d"%i, sweep_tube(points=pts,radius=.040,color=green))
    chaise.include("leg_gold_%d"%i,
                   sweep_tube(points=[(a,b-.035,c) for a,b,c in pts],radius=.008,color=pale_gold))
    chaise.include("foot_%d"%i,
                   fillet_box((.11,.09,.055),radius=.024,
                              center=(pts[-1][0],pts[-1][1],.056),color=gold))

# Upholstered head, with a shaped crown. A mesh is added below inside this frame.
head_outline = [(-1.45,-.53,.69),(-1.54,-.55,1.18),(-1.59,-.50,1.63),
                (-1.54,-.40,1.85),(-1.48,-.17,1.91),(-1.43,.10,1.87),
                (-1.38,.36,1.71),(-1.33,.51,1.62),(-1.25,.54,1.48),
                (-1.18,.54,.80)]
chaise.include("head_carved_frame", sweep_tube(points=head_outline,radius=.047,color=green))
chaise.include("head_gilt_bead",
               sweep_tube(points=[(x+.023,y-.007,z) for x,y,z in head_outline],
                          radius=.012,color=pale_gold))

         (-.91,-.59,1.26),(-.77,-.58,1.17),(-.68,-.575,.94),(-.53,-.57,.73)]
arm_bottom=[(-1.45,-.54,.76),(-1.23,-.58,.66),(-.91,-.58,.61),(-.60,-.57,.61),(-.53,-.57,.73)]
chaise.include("near_arm_frame",sweep_tube(points=arm_top,radius=.047,color=green))
chaise.include("near_arm_lower",sweep_tube(points=arm_bottom,radius=.04,color=green))
for j, path in enumerate((arm_top, arm_bottom)):
    chaise.include("arm_gold_%d"%j,
                   sweep_tube(points=[(x,y-.038,z+.004) for x,y,z in path],
                              radius=.012,color=pale_gold))
# Far side short rising carved arm.
far_arm=[(-1.40,.49,1.72),(-1.18,.55,1.52),(-.88,.56,1.41),
         (-.65,.55,1.40),(-.61,.55,1.18),(-.48,.54,.91)]
chaise.include("far_arm",sweep_tube(points=far_arm,radius=.04,color=green))
chaise.include("far_arm_gold",
               sweep_tube(points=[(x,y-.02,z+.025) for x,y,z in far_arm],
                          radius=.011,color=pale_gold))
# Upholstered far arm body.
chaise.include("far_arm_upholstery",
               fillet_box((.65,.075,.38),radius=.035,center=(-.98,.52,1.18),color=fabric))

# Carved scrolls along front apron and crown.
for group, (cx,cy,cz,scale) in enumerate([(.22,-.657,.55,.15),(-1.49,-.38,1.86,.10),
                                         (1.34,-.50,.56,.09),(-.76,-.63,1.22,.07)]):
    for sign in (-1,1):
        pts=[]
        for k in range(30):
            a=k/29*math.pi*2.0
            r=scale*(1-.78*k/29)
            pts.append((cx+sign*(.025+r*math.cos(a)),cy-.006*math.sin(a),cz+.55*r*math.sin(a)))
        chaise.include("scroll_%d_%d"%(group,sign),sweep_tube(points=pts,radius=.009,color=pale_gold))
    for k in range(5):
        a=math.pi*k/4
        leaf=ball(.026,center=(cx+.064*math.cos(a),cy-.004,cz+.040*math.sin(a)),color=gold)
        leaf.resize((.65,.4,1.0))
        chaise.include("rosette_%d_%d"%(group,k),leaf)
scene.include("chaise",chaise)

# Cream pillow resting against the head.
pillow=Asset("Loose cream pillow")
p=fillet_box((.27,.69,.68),radius=.12,center=(-1.13,-.015,1.31),color=(.91,.84,.68))
p.turn("y",-18)
p.turn("x",-7)
pillow.include("pillow_body",p)
scene.include("pillow",pillow)

# Small green museum label on the seat.
label=Asset("Seat label")
card=box((.19,.095,.008),center=(.72,.13,.970),color=(.055,.24,.19))
card.turn("z",8)
label.include("green_card",card)
for i in range(4):
    line=box((.065,.003,.001),center=(.71+i*.014,.13,.975),color=(.72,.78,.64))
    line.turn("z",90+8)
    label.include("printed_line_%d"%i,line)
scene.include("label",label)

# Window surround and softly folded curtains at the left.
curtain=Asset("Curtains")
curtain.include("bright_window",box((.10,1.3,3.3),center=(-2.13,.18,1.7),color=(.96,.94,.84)))
for i in range(13):
    y=-.65+i*.085
    x=-2.08+.035*math.sin(i*1.8)
    curtain.include("ivory_fold_%d"%i,
                    rod(radius=.060,start=(x,y,.10),end=(x-.08,y,3.2),
                        color=(.83+.035*(i%3),.80+.035*(i%3),.70+.04*(i%3))))
for i in range(5):
    curtain.include("gold_edge_%d"%i,
                    rod(radius=.025,start=(-1.98+i*.024,-.69,.03),
                        end=(-2.13+i*.026,-.69,3.2),color=(.52+i*.035,.41+i*.035,.28+i*.03)))
scene.include("curtains",curtain)

# Cropped cane chair in the lower-left foreground.
chair=Asset("Foreground cane chair")
chair.include("seat_frame",
              fillet_box((.84,.78,.10),radius=.045,center=(-1.53,-1.90,.48),color=green))
chair.include("cane_base",
              box((.72,.66,.018),center=(-1.53,-1.90,.542),color=(.48,.32,.18)))
for i in range(30):

    chair.include("cane_x_%d"%i,
                  rod(radius=.004,start=(xx,-2.20,.556),end=(xx,-1.60,.556),
                      color=(.69,.52,.31)))

    yy=-2.21+i*.024
    chair.include("cane_y_%d"%i,
                  rod(radius=.004,start=(-1.87,yy,.558),end=(-1.19,yy,.558),
                      color=(.70,.53,.33)))
for i,yy in enumerate((-2.24,-1.56)):
    chair.include("seat_gilt_%d"%i,

realize(scene)

# Mesh helpers for tailored, curved upholstery.
def mesh_object(name, vertices, faces, material):
    mesh=bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    mesh.from_pydata(vertices,[],faces)
    mesh.update()
    ob=bpy.data.objects.new(name,mesh)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(ob)
    ob.data.materials.append(material)
    for poly in mesh.polygons:
        poly.use_smooth=True
    return ob

def textile(name, base, patterned=False):
    mat=bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    mat.diffuse_color=(*base,1)
    mat.use_nodes=True
    nodes=mat.node_tree.nodes
    links=mat.node_tree.links
    bs=nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    bs.inputs["Base Color"].default_value=(*base,1)
    bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.91
    tex=nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
    noise=nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
    noise.inputs["Scale"].default_value=155
    noise.inputs["Detail"].default_value=2
    links.new(tex.outputs["Generated"],noise.inputs["Vector"])
    bump=nodes.new("ShaderNodeBump")
    bump.inputs["Strength"].default_value=.17
    bump.inputs["Distance"].default_value=.018
    links.new(noise.outputs["Fac"],bump.inputs["Height"])
    links.new(bump.outputs["Normal"],bs.inputs["Normal"])
    if patterned:
        wave=nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexWave")
        wave.wave_type="BANDS"
        wave.bands_direction="Y"
        wave.inputs["Scale"].default_value=13
        wave.inputs["Distortion"].default_value=.20
        links.new(tex.outputs["Generated"],wave.inputs["Vector"])
        ramp=nodes.new("ShaderNodeValToRGB")
        cr=ramp.color_ramp
        cr.elements.remove(cr.elements[1])
        for idx,(pos,color) in enumerate([
            (0.0,base),(.73,base),(.79,(.65,.47,.43)),
            (.83,base),(.92,base),(.955,(.73,.58,.50)),(1.0,base)]):
            e=cr.elements[0] if idx==0 else cr.elements.new(pos)
            e.position=pos
            e.color=(*color,1)
        links.new(wave.outputs["Color"],ramp.inputs["Fac"])
        links.new(ramp.outputs["Color"],bs.inputs["Base Color"])
    return mat

cloth=textile("Woven ivory and faded rose stripes",fabric,True)

# Rounded long seat: a superellipsoid retains a broad, nearly flat top.

for j in range(M):
    for i in range(N):
        a=j*N+i
        b=j*N+(i+1)%N
        faces.append((a,b,b+N,a+N))
seat=mesh_object("Continuous upholstered chaise mattress",verts,faces,cloth)

headverts=[
    (-1.41,-.49,.79),(-1.48,-.50,1.20),(-1.51,-.46,1.61),
    (-1.47,-.37,1.79),(-1.41,-.16,1.85),(-1.36,.10,1.81),

head=mesh_object("Head upholstered panel",headverts,headfaces,cloth)
solid=head.modifiers.new("Upholstery thickness","SOLIDIFY")

    (-1.51,-.548,1.51),(-1.37,-.56,1.36),(-1.11,-.565,1.26),
    (-.92,-.56,1.22),(-.81,-.56,1.13),(-.73,-.56,.92),
    (-.57,-.55,.72),(-.64,-.55,.66),(-.93,-.55,.66),
    (-1.22,-.55,.71),(-1.42,-.54,.81),(-1.23,-.58,1.00)]
sidefaces=[(i,(i+1)%11,11) for i in range(11)]
side=mesh_object("Near upholstered curved side",sideverts,sidefaces,cloth)

for ob in bpy.data.objects:
    if ob.type=="MESH":
        parent=ob
        names=[]
        while parent:
            names.append(parent.name.lower())

petalmat.use_nodes=True
petalmat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"].inputs["Base Color"].default_value=(.56,.37,.34,1)
petalmat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"].inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.95
fv=[]
ff=[]
